description: This Java interface defines the write platform service for handling teller transactions in the Fineract project. It declares a method to create and store teller transaction records based on provided commands.

classes.name: TellerTransactionWritePlatformService
classes.description: An interface providing methods to handle teller transaction write operations.

methods.name: createTellerTransaction
methods.description: Creates a new teller transaction based on the provided command and returns the processing result.
